title: Homemade Maple Yogurt Recipe
description: This homemade maple yogurt recipe mimics the rich, creamy taste and texture of Brown Cow maple yogurt, so now you can simply make in your own kitchen.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons plain yogurt, at room temperature
0.5 cup heavy whipping cream, at room temperature

steps.text: Heat milk in a medium saucepan over medium heat until it comes to a lively simmer; stir in powdered milk and sugar until dissolved. Cool until an instant-read thermometer reads 110 degrees F (43 degrees C), about 30 minutes.

Place plain yogurt in a bowl; whisk in a small amount of milk mixture until combined. Whisk yogurt mixture back into milk mixture in the saucepan in a thin stream, whisking constantly, until well combined. Whisk in heavy cream and maple extract to combine.
Pour yogurt mixture into 7 individual serving jars. Process in a yogurt maker according to manufacturer's instructions, for 8 hours. Chill at least 3 hours before serving.
